svg.title: ayush.ts — About Ayush Kumar Saini
svg.desc: B.S. (Hons.) Chemistry at IIT Kharagpur, 2023 to 2027. Builds ML systems you can audit, LLM infrastructure, low-latency C++ and real-time web apps. Languages: C++20, Python, TypeScript, Go, SQL. Last role: Summer Associate, Tech Intern at ReachIvy, May to July 2026. Open to SDE and ML or data science roles, class of 2027. Ask about fraud detection, hybrid-search RAG, matching engines and WebRTC. Motto: measure it, test it, then ship it.

text.tspan: "measure it, test it, then ship it"
// chemistry taught me to measure twice
